[
  {
    "gene": "ACHE",
    "target_id": "ENSG00000087085",
    "evidence_types": [
      "Human clinical intervention: randomized-trial meta-analysis found small cognitive benefits from the acetylcholinesterase inhibitor donepezil in Alzheimer dementia (PMID:29923184).",
      "Biochemical experiment: recombinant human acetylcholinesterase accelerated amyloid-beta fibril assembly in vitro through its peripheral binding site; this effect was distinct from catalytic activity (PMID:8608006)."
    ],
    "direction": "Inhibit acetylcholinesterase catalytic activity to increase synaptic acetylcholine and improve cognitive symptoms. Symptomatic benefit is established; disease modification is not. Peripheral-site blockade is a separate exploratory anti-aggregation hypothesis."
  },
  {
    "gene": "APP",
    "target_id": "ENSG00000142192",
    "evidence_types": [
      "Human genetics: APP A673T protects against Alzheimer disease and age-related cognitive decline, supporting reduced amyloidogenic processing (PMID:22801501).",
      "Human clinical intervention: lecanemab targeting APP-derived amyloid-beta protofibrils modestly slowed cognitive and functional decline in early Alzheimer disease (PMID:36449413)."
    ],
    "direction": "Reduce pathogenic APP-derived amyloid-beta production or enhance its clearance while preserving physiological APP function. Clinical evidence supports targeting the amyloid-beta product, not indiscriminate APP inhibition; benefit is stage-dependent and amyloid-directed therapy carries ARIA risk."
  },
  {
    "gene": "MAPT",
    "target_id": "ENSG00000186868",
    "evidence_types": [
      "Animal model: reducing endogenous tau ameliorated amyloid-beta-induced deficits in an Alzheimer disease mouse model (PMID:17478722).",
      "Human clinical target engagement: a phase 1b randomized trial of MAPT-targeting antisense oligonucleotide reduced CSF tau in mild Alzheimer disease; this trial did not establish cognitive efficacy (PMID:37095250).
